| Average power usage | 2kWh station | 4kWh station |
|---|---:|---:|
| 100W (router, lights, small electronics) | 17 hours | 34 hours |
| 200W (fridge + essentials) | 8.5 hours | 17 hours |
| 500W (multiple appliances) | 3.4 hours | 6.8 hours |
| 1,000W (heavy load) | 1.7 hours | 3.4 hours |

**Important:** If you want to power your home's electrical circuits rather than plug appliances directly into the station, you'll need a compatible transfer switch or home power panel installed by a qualified electrician. Never backfeed a household outlet.

## What I'd buy

For refrigerator, Wi-Fi, lights and electronics, I'd choose the **EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3**. For more demanding appliances or a future whole-home system, I'd favor the **Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus**.
